content.text:
Wolfram|Alpha gives **∫₀⁵ 3e^(2x) dx = 3/2 (e¹⁰ − 1) ≈ 33038**.

I entered "integral of 3e^(2x) from x=0 to x=5" in the search box, and the page showed that result under "Definite integral". The indefinite integral it lists is (3e^(2x))/2 + C. My own check agrees: e¹⁰ ≈ 22026.466, so 1.5 × 22025.466 ≈ 33038.2.
